chunks: From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the minimum of qunut, so he said, 'Five tasbihs.'
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of qunut required in Shia prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the jurisprudential minimum (*adna*) for the *qunut* in Shia prayer, establishing that five glorifications suffice to fulfill the recommended act. This brevity underscores the Shia emphasis on the essence of supplication over length, distinguishing the obligatory *qunut* of the Fajr prayer from the extended supplications often found in other traditions. It reflects the practical flexibility granted to the worshipper while maintaining the sanctity of the gesture.
